passCriteria: Selected article images appear in document order in the real overlay.
Images fit the overlay at normal and narrow window sizes without distortion or horizontal page overflow.
Image alt text never enters speech; surrounding words and captions retain exact canonical character mapping.
Copied handlers, styles, navigation, unsafe URLs, SVG data, and unrelated source elements are excluded.
A second reading clears old images; plain text and tables still render correctly.

tests.title: Copy a selected article with a relative image and caption
tests.userStory: Read a selected article while seeing its included image in the pop-up.
tests.setup: Local HTTP article fixture in Chromium, actual browser Copy, production clipboard reader, production overlay HTML and preload, synthetic alignment without provider usage.
steps: Copy selection and read HTML clipboard content
Send captured HTML to the overlay
Wait for image decode and inspect visible order
expectedResults: Selected image decodes in the overlay
Canonical speech excludes image alt text
Clipboard HTML resolves relative image URL
proof: Clipboard HTML and renderer result assertions

tests.title: Resize and read a new selection
tests.userStory: Keep images readable at small sizes and avoid old images leaking into another reading.
tests.setup: Same production overlay, a large raster image and a second article with a picture fallback plus embedded PNG.
steps: Check image bounds and aspect ratio
Check old images are removed and new images decode
expectedResults: Second reading contains only new images

tests.title: Unsafe and broken images, plain text and tables
tests.userStory: Read copied material safely without disrupting existing reading layouts.
tests.setup: Hostile clipboard HTML with event handlers, file/script/blob/SVG data URLs, a missing HTTP image, and a table. Production CSP remains active.
steps: Inspect rebuilt attributes and attempted requests
Load plain-text reading and inspect words
expectedResults: Only allowed image URLs are rendered
Missing image does not interrupt text
Plain text reading has no stale images
